why: Each script is specified, but commit 2 rewraps every CI step, the three quick-gate steps included, through a new scripts/timed.mjs: if the wrapper loses the child's exit code (a spawn 'close' handled wrongly, a pipe in --unit mode, an exit after the ceiling check), a failing lint, type check or test goes green and the push deploys to production. ci-recorder.scan.test.ts checks only that commands are wrapped, not that failures still fail, and the step also adds new hard failures (setup over 10%, a test file that did not run) that were never measured.
harm_if_wrong: A quick gate that passes a broken build so it deploys, or a static job that goes red on every push from an invented limit, neither caught by the scan test.
make_it_cheaper: Add a planted case to ci-recorder.scan.test.ts that runs scripts/timed.mjs on `node -e "process.exit(3)"` (also with --unit) and expects exit 3, and make the setup-share and file-comparison rules print-only until ceilings exist.
brief_problems: The --unit mode fails the run when setup is over 10% of the unit run and when a file on disk did not run, both from day one; that contradicts 'Do not invent ceilings' and can turn the static job red on the first push.
--warm-if=.eslintcache can never be true today (lint has no cache, as the brief itself notes), so lint:warm is a key that never fills.
